item.title: 2025 Swammy Awards: Heart Of A Champion – Jack Punswick
item.description: By Terin Frodyma on SwimSwam Following a 2024 Kansas 6A state title, Punswick was diagnosed with stage II Hodgkin's Lymphoma. He returned to finish 2nd in 2025 and became cancer free. Read the full story on SwimSwam: 2025 Swammy Awards: Heart Of A Champion – Jack Punswick
